name: trsm-indoor-navigator
description: TRSM Indoor Navigator — independent demonstration prototype of 3D indoor navigation for TRSM floors 7–9.

scripts.data:build: mkdir -p .data && python3 -I tools/extract.py data-source/TRSM-Maps-2024.pdf .data/raw.json && python3 -I tools/build_dataset.py .data/raw.json data-source/TRSM-Maps-2024.pdf .data && python3 -I tools/build_routing.py .data/stage1.json src/data/generated
scripts.test:all: vitest run && next build && playwright test
